t: The $(5)Anti-Spawn Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). With this module installed, the Matrix will prevent hostile or friendly entities from spawning within its action area. If a player posseses a spawn egg, standing just outside the action range of the Matrix will let them spawn the entity inside the protected region.
$(5)反生成模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块。安装此模块后，干涉矩阵将阻止敌对或友方实体在其作用区域内生成。若玩家持有刷怪蛋，只需站在干涉矩阵作用范围外，即可在受保护区域内生成该实体。
